text.en: Emergent abilities is row 56 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: Emergent abilities 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 56 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table associates Emergent abilities with “Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Emergent abilities 与论文《Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Jason Wei, William Fedus”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Jason Wei（官方页拼写）、William Fedus（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Jason Wei, William Fedus”。
